explication: PAL MCP is an MCP server that lets a CLI or IDE client invoke specialized AI tools, retain conversation context, and use multiple model providers. The main path is client request → server dispatch and model resolution → simple or guided workflow tool → provider response → MCP result. Workflow tools support distinct activities such as code review, debugging, planning, and validation; the separate clink bridge launches external AI CLIs. The README documents broader capabilities than the sampled implementation excerpts, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
